synopsis: During the Scourge invasion, Falanaras is a conscripted civilian from minor House Dawnspear, thrown into a defense far beyond his training. After the city’s barriers fail, he finds his home destroyed and his father dead, then survives the retreat beside Theron Brightshield, Lethira Valeflame, and Captain Rynel Starweaver. At an inner-gate evacuation point, he briefly sees High Priestess Liadrin tending the wounded through desperate faith before she continues toward the defense of the Sunwell. From the margins of the kingdom’s collapse, Falanaras witnesses Sylvanas’s desecration, King Anasterian’s distant last stand, Arthas’s corruption of the Sunwell, and Silvermoon’s ruin. After the Scourge withdraws and before Kael’thas returns, he chooses permanent martial service because Quel’Thalas—and the survivors still within it—are all he has left.
title: Chapter 1: The Sundering of Silvermoon
